title: 지하철역 이름 소리 듣기: 왜 [설릉]이라고 해요?
objective: You can say how a written word with ㄴ–ㄹ changes or an added ㄴ sound is pronounced, and find the spelling of a place you hear or see in English.
summary: Learn two Korean sound changes, ㄴ–ㄹ changes and the added ㄴ sound, through real Seoul subway station names.
note: All station names are real Seoul subway stations. The sounds in [ ] follow standard Korean pronunciation.

task.title: Hear it, read it, spell it
task.line: Use the two rules on page 1 to write the sound, choose the spelling, or fix the word.

sections.heading: Two sound rules
paragraphs: Rule 1 — ㄴ and ㄹ meet. ㄴ+ㄹ or ㄹ+ㄴ sounds like [ㄹㄹ]: 선릉 [설릉], 칼날 [칼랄]. After ㅁ or ㅇ, ㄹ sounds like ㄴ: 종로 [종노]. After ㄱ or ㅂ, ㄹ sounds like ㄴ, and then ㄱ→ㅇ, ㅂ→ㅁ: 독립문 [동님문].

Rule 2 — an added ㄴ. In a compound word, if the first part ends in a consonant and the second part starts with 이, 야, 여, 요, or 유, add a ㄴ sound: 색연필 [생년필]. After ㄹ, this ㄴ becomes ㄹ: 서울역 [서울력]. This doesn't happen in every word, for example 목요일 [모교일].

items.text: Sounds like [설릉]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.
Sounds like [종노]: ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.
Sounds like [음뇨]: ㄹ after ㅁ becomes ㄴ.
Sounds like [왕심니]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ, then ㅂ becomes ㅁ.
Sounds like [동님문]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ, then ㄱ becomes ㅇ.
Sounds like [생년필]: a ㄴ sound is added before 연, then ㄱ becomes ㅇ.
Sounds like [항녀울]: a ㄴ sound is added, then ㄱ becomes ㅇ.
Sounds like [서울력]: the added ㄴ becomes ㄹ after ㄹ.

sections.heading: Tip: Use the English sign
paragraphs: Korean spelling stays the same even when the sound changes, but English station signs follow the sound: 선릉 is Seolleung, 왕십리 is Wangsimni, 학여울 is Hangnyeoul. If you can't find a name you heard on the map, change [ㄹㄹ] back to ㄴㄹ or ㄹㄴ, change [ㅇㄴ] or [ㅁㄴ] back to ㅇㄹ, ㅁㄹ, ㄱㄹ, or ㅂㄹ, or take away an added ㄴ.

exercises: Write how each word sounds in [ ]: ① 난로 ② 정류장 ③ 국립
Yes or No: Is a ㄴ sound added? ① 집안일 ② 목요일 ③ 한여름
You hear this on the subway. The spelling on the map is different from the sound. Choose the station name you will see on the map: 이번 역은 [물래], [물래]역입니다. (문래 / 물래 / 문내)
The English sign says "Gongneung". Choose the Korean spelling: 골릉 / 공릉 / 곤릉
A friend typed these words the way they sound. Write the correct spelling: ① 실래 ② 펼리해요
answers: ① Yes [지반닐] ② No [모교일] ③ Yes [한녀름]
